text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon received a fan letter,
so I decided to hand it to her.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, you went out of your way
to write me a letter?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
And there's so many of them...!
It's a whole cardboard box full.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Having people who support you
really is something to be happy about, isn't it!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Man, I've really gotta live up to their hopes
and deliver results out on the track!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Now that that's decided,
let's start training right away!

Fired up, Hishi Amazon's
training continued well into the night.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Hoo, hoo, hoo...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Alright, one more rep!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Something like this is nothing to me!
After all, I'm the "Clutch Big Sis Hishi Ama"!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Actually, while I was taking a break earlier,
I read some of my fan letters."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Someone who watched the race praised me, saying I was 'clutch.'

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: "‘Even against superior opponents, she hung on till the very end, fighting fair and square’... or so they say!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"I want to keep challenging myself without giving up on my dreams too,"
"Thank you for giving me courage!" That's what they said!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I was so happy, my heart was burning up...
All my exhaustion just blew away in an instant!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"How could I not answer a letter like that?
That's just the way I roll!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, that's what I'm talking about!
We're just getting started with training!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"There are tons of absolute monsters
swarming all over the races, you know."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"I'm fixing to go one-on-one with them.
No amount of training could ever be enough!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Watch closely, Trainy!
You're gonna be my witness!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
That I really am the "clutch Umamusume"
just like in those fan letters!
That day, Hishi Amazon kept running laps right up until curfew.
